text.p: American Industrial Properties REIT said Wednesday it agreed to buy four real estate limited partnerships for a total of $89.6 million.

The real estate investment trust said it will issue an aggregate of 22 million shares of beneficial interests at $2.625 a share (for a total value of $57.9 million) in exchange for the partnerships' interests in the real estate limited partnerships.
The trust said the number of shares it issues will equal each partnership's net asset value divided by $2.625.

The trust said it signed definitive merger agreements with USAA Real Estate Income Investments I, a California LP; USAA Real Estate Income Investments II LP; USAA Income Properties III LP; and USAA Income Properties IV LP.
The partnerships are affiliates of USAA Real Estate Co, which owns 31.8 percent of the trust's outstanding shares. The trust first announced the deal June 10.

It added that the merger is a taxable transaction to the partnerships and will be subject to the completion of a joint proxy statement and prospectus filed on Form S-4 with the Securities and Exchange Commission. It added it had not scheduled a date for a shareholders meetings and limited partner meetings to vote on the deal.

Amewrican Industrial also said an investment group headed by Morgan Stanley Dean Witter Discover & Co's Morgan Stanley Asset Management Inc bought about $12.6 million of its shares at $2.45 per share under a previously announced agreement.

The investment group can buy up to to $20 million in shares at the price of $2.45 per share, the trust said, adding it anticipated the group will buy an additional $4.9 million in shares later this week and the balance after the Trust places additional equity.

The trust also said ABKB/LaSalle Securities Ltd bought $15 million of shares at $2.45 per share for some of its clients. The trust said it will use the proceeds from these transactions to buy additional industrial properties.
The trust's stock traded unchanged at 3 Wednesday afternoon.
